protocol.execution_loop: 每节点八步闭环=读 WHY/WHAT/HOW→先补最低层 proof（旧败新胜）→迁 ownership/contract→迁全部 production callers→删旧路径→owner proof+受影响 gate+node scripts/check.mjs+node scripts/build.mjs 绿→提交置 DONE 释放后继

roles.Coder: 拥有 mutation 与测试实现
roles.Technician: 拥有运行证据、门禁与构建验证
roles.Analyst: 拥有 owner 争议与架构边裁决

protocol.concurrency_policy: 同文件冲突=edit mutex 不造永久边；READY 节点 touched_paths 正交即可并行
protocol.acyclic_invariant: 新节点/边入账即查环，Kahn 拓扑排序校验
